summary: The 24K Magic World Tour was Bruno Mars's fourth concert tour, held from March 2017 to December 2018 to support his album 24K Magic. It played Europe, North America, Latin America, Asia and Oceania, and included Mars's first show in Africa, in Morocco. Opening acts included Anderson .Paak, Camila Cabello and Dua Lipa. More than one million tickets sold in a single day after it was announced. Mars was backed by his eight-piece band, The Hooligans, and choreographed the shows with Phil Tayag. The setlist mixed songs from 24K Magic with songs from his earlier albums and "Uptown Funk". Critics generally praised his showmanship, his guitar playing and the stage production. The tour grossed over $396 million, making it one of the highest-grossing concert tours of all time. It won two Pollstar awards and two Billboard Music Awards.
